audience.description: Who it is aimed at (sales: ICP, segment).

budget.description: Default spend cap (sales: insertion order, flight budget). Changed at runtime; every change is kept.

cap.description: Most to spend, as a number such as 200 or 200.50; 0 means nothing is planned to be spent.

currency.description: 3-letter currency code, e.g. USD. Spend must be recorded in the same currency.

channels.description: Where it runs, e.g. hn, x, newsletter, search (sales: media mix).

code.description: Short code for landing-page variants and attribution: a signal or funnel event carrying campaign=<code> counts for this campaign.

creatives.description: Creatives (ad creative, social cards): an HTML template plus copy fields, rendered at each size.

alt.description: Alt text, kept with the image and used as {{alt}}.

copy.description: Text for each placeholder in the template. Checked against claims; an edit withdraws approval.

sizes.description: Sizes to render, WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, e.g. 1200x627.

source.description: Where numbers in the copy come from (a study, claims.md). Numbers found neither here nor in claims.md are flagged.

template.description: HTML file in the product folder with {{field}} placeholders; {{width}} and {{height}} are filled per size. Keep CSS and images beside it.

end.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD; empty means open-ended.

gate.description: Checklist that must be fully checked before any spend (sales: pre-flight checklist). Spend before it is complete is allowed but flagged.

goal.description: What this campaign is for, in a sentence.

label.description: Human name; also shown in campaigns.json for per-campaign landing pages.

landing.description: https URL of this campaign's landing page (a per-campaign page measures better than shared ones).

offer.description: The one thing it asks people to do.

start.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (sales: flight start). Can be changed at runtime.

stop_rule.description: When to stop, in words and optionally as a rule a machine can check. Astrolabe warns; it never stops or spends by itself.

when.description: Machine-checkable form: spend has reached spend_pct percent of the cap and success events are at most max_events.

max_events.description: Most success events so far for the rule to apply (default 0: zero results).

success_event.description: What counts as a result: a funnel stage (e.g. signup) or a signal type (e.g. form.request).

tasks.description: Launch tasks, such as posting a Show HN. Each becomes a task with the posted URL recorded when done.

body.description: The post text. {{link}} becomes the campaign link. Checked against claims; flagged posts wait.

channel.description: Where, e.g. hn, x, linkedin, reddit, newsletter.

day.description: Days after the campaign start (negative is before) when it is due.

title.description: What to do, e.g. Post Show HN.
